note: City of New Boston park on Sturgeon Bay, a Mississippi backwater, with boat ramps and a splash park. Many sites are held by monthly and yearly campers, the front row nearest the water among them. Outside water may not be on until mid-April or may be shut off by mid-October in bad weather. --Claude
summary: City camping page (modified 2026-06) read, Google Maps, Esri export + z18/z19 tiles. Riverview kept (open sand lot between the west RV row and the bay ~80 m; the RVs nearest the water sit behind a ~40 m tree stand; no levee). $30 kept, season and phone-to-City-Hall booking confirmed. Nightly share not measurable; mostly-seasonal flagged. Hookups/sites/showers unsourced, left. Pin OK.
flags: WATERFRONT: riverview KEPT (checked hard; not --AWH). Sturgeon Bay here is ~80 m+ wide (not creekside). The westernmost RV row sits along the shore road at ~41.1694-41.1700,-91.0030 and looks west across an open sand ramp/parking lot to the water ~80 m away (shore ~-91.0040). The units closest to the water (~41.1706,-91.0036 and ~41.1702,-91.0032) are 36-55 m from the beach but behind a dense ~40 m tree stand - view at most, and these look like seasonal set-ups. No site is within ~50 m over open ground. No levee: the sites and the beach sit on flat open ground at the shore.

SEASONAL SHARE (flag for reviewer): the page sells daily, weekly, monthly ('$290; $320 for front row') and yearly ('$2,280.00;$2,490.00') RV rates; imagery shows many units with decks/sheds, and a 2015 page comment says the waterfront lots are 'homesteaded by a few'. No site count or nightly-site count on the page, so the nightly share could not be measured. Not iffy by the reviewer test (current rate on a page modified 2026-06-12; Google 4.7 / 70), and the page invites reservations ('Make your reservations and plan your stay'). City-owned, so the private long-stay tests don't strictly apply. Note says mostly seasonal.
SITES/HOOKUPS/FACILITIES (not changed): count 70, electric 50 / water / sewer and showers are note-derived; the city page states none of them. Left (silence).
RATING: stored RV Life 1 star; Google 4.7 / 70 reviews.
